review.posthog_relevance: Changes the visual presentation of playback scale percentage and number formatting in the session recording player, potentially improving readability and alignment stability.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized maintenance and presentation update. P1.F1.H1 removes a decimal point and adds a comment regarding flickering prevention. P1.F2.H1 adds a CSS class for tabular numerals to prevent font width shifting. These are cosmetic and stability improvements rather than substantive capability or correctness changes.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of removing the decimal point or using tabular numerals is not demonstrated by the code execution or test results, only the implementation is present. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.behavior: Replaces the scale display formatting to use 0 decimal places instead of 1, removing the decimal point. P1.F1.H1 also adds a comment explaining this removes flickering caused by near-identical values settling.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the visual representation of the playback scale percentage in the session recording player, potentially improving readability and stability of the display.

observations.behavior: Adds the CSS class 'tabular-nums' to the span containing the scale display, while keeping the resolution display unchanged. P1.F2.H1 does not change the underlying value, only the presentation style.
